The body is application/x-ndjson (Content-Type), not JSON: one record per line, at most 1,000 records or 4 MB per call. Records are Ecommerce's stored shapes, every one with optional createdAt and updatedAt: size_charts { id (szc_), name, unit, columns, rows, fitAdvice, notes, active }; categories { id (cat_), slug, name, parentId, description, seo, image, sort, status, icon, content, faqs, sizeChartId, requiresSerial, previousSlugs }; brands { id (brd_), slug, name, description, logo, status, categoryIds, seo, sizeChartId }; attributes { id (att_), name, type, choices, unit, slug, categoryIds, on, multiple, visibility, card, active, seo … }; landings { id (lnd_), categoryId, brandId, grade, h1, title, description, intro, faqs, indexable }; products { id (prd_), slug, name, kind, status, … variants (var_ ids), media, sold, rating, publishedAt, previousSlugs } (a product without a variant is stored as a draft); serials { id (ser_), productId, variantId, serial, status, orderId, lineId, locationId }; deals (deal_) and bundles (bnd_) with their use count used; customers { id (cus_), userId, name, email, phone, city, blocked … }; orders { id (ord_), number, customer, address, delivery, lines, totals, promotions, payment, payments, refunds, status, history, shipment … } (money in minor units, adding up as checkout adds it); loyalty { customerId, userId, lots, history … }; reviews (rev_); returns (ret_); alerts (alr_); wishlists { userId, productIds }. description.description: The meta description: the product's SEO description, else the productDescription pattern, its summary, its description as text, or the seo setting defaultDescription.

canonical.description: The product's canonicalUrl, else its page.

image.description: The social image: its ogImage, else its first photo, else the seo setting defaultImage (null: none).

jsonLd.description: The JSON-LD (a ProductGroup with its variants, offers, conditions, shipping, return policy, reviews and FAQs, and a BreadcrumbList) as text safe to put in a script tag.

Serial.description: One unit of a product variant with its serial number (such as an IMEI).

serial.description: Unique in the website. Recorded here: letters, digits, spaces and . _ / : # -; typed when packing: any text.

status.description: sold: captured on an order when it was packed (back in_stock when the order is cancelled or returned).

orderId.description: The order a sold unit belongs to.

locationId.description: Where the unit is kept (Multi-location stock).

typed.description: Typed by staff when packing (serial mode typed): never was in stock; deleted when it leaves its order.

SerialPage.description: One page of serial numbers, by serial number.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as cursor for the next page (null: the last page).

ShopDeal.description: A live deal as shoppers see it (no use counts, priority or rule details).

type.description: percent or fixed off, or free_delivery (no delivery fee while it covers a line of the cart).

target.description: items: off each unit of the lines it covers; cart: off those lines together (a percent of their amount, or one fixed amount spread over them). Always items for free_delivery.

value.description: percent: the percent (above 0, at most 100, decimals allowed); fixed: minor units; free_delivery: 0.

slug.description: The deal page’s address part, unique per website ('': none); shoppers open a deal by id or slug.

badgeLabel.description: A short label for product cards ('': none).

discountLabel.description: How the saving reads, for example "10% off" ('': none).

url.description: The photo’s address (null when storage is not connected).

minQuantity.description: Least units of a line (0: none).

cartTotal.description: Least the cart’s goods come to, minor units (0: none).

paymentMethods.description: Only with these payment methods ([]: any).

days.description: Weekdays it applies on, 0 = Sunday ([]: every day), in the business time zone.

timeFrom.description: HH:MM it starts each day ('': midnight), business time zone.

timeTo.description: HH:MM it stops each day ('': midnight); before timeFrom it runs past midnight.

allowPoints.description: false: points cannot be redeemed on an order it applies to.

startsAt.description: From when it applies (inclusive); null: from now on.

endsAt.description: Until when it applies (exclusive); null: no end.

everything.description: It covers every product (the lists are empty).

value.description: What the balance is worth at checkout, minor units.

currency.description: The shop's currency (the catalog setting currency, an ISO 4217 code such as USD or PKR).

pointValue.description: What one point is worth, minor units.

maxPercent.description: Most of an order paid with points.

pending.description: Points the shopper’s orders not yet delivered will earn.

expiringSoon.description: Points that expire within 30 days, by expiry, soonest first.

ShopPolicies.description: The shop's policies from the checkout settings, placeholders filled; empty policies are left out.

format.description: The checkout setting policyFormat: html texts are cleaned to p, br, strong, em, u, ul, ol, li, h2, h3, h4, blockquote and safe links.

ShopReview.description: An approved review as visitors see it.

name.description: The reviewer's name: the whole name, or with the reviews setting nameFormat: first_initial the first name and the last name's initial ("Ayesha K."). '' when unknown.

variantName.description: The variant bought, for example 'Red / XL' ('' for none).

body.description: The review text (plain text, new lines kept).

reply.description: Your staff's public reply ('' for none).

ShopReviewPage.description: One page of a product's approved reviews, with the rating summary of all of them.

nextCursor.description: Pass it as cursor for the next page (null: the last page).

SizeChart.description: A size chart (E5), with how many records name it.

active.description: false: product pages do not show it.

uses.description: How many products, brands and categories name it (sizeChartId).

key.description: Lowercase letters, digits, _ and -; unique in the chart.

SizeChartInput.description: A member left out keeps its value (a new chart: its default). Unknown members are ignored.

values.description: Column key → value: a key of the chart's columns (as sent, else as stored), a text or number of at most 60 characters.

SizeChartList.description: Every size chart (at most 1,000), by name.

size.description: For example M; unique in the chart.

label.description: Shown name (the size when not given).

values.description: Column key → value (empty values are left out).

StockAgeReport.description: Active products that track stock and have some, by how long they have waited.

rows.description: The longest wait since a sale first, at most 500.

publishedAt.description: When it was first published (else created).

daysSinceSale.description: Whole days since its last sale, or since publishedAt when never sold.

TaxonomyImage.description: A category's image or a brand's logo in the merchant's storage, with its address (the catalog setting mediaBaseUrl, else a link signed for an hour).

key.description: The storage key (ecommerce/categories/<id>/… or ecommerce/brands/<id>/…; an imported file may be elsewhere).

type.description: The content type, for example image/webp ('' when an import did not give it).

sizes.description: Storage keys of the smaller copies the uploader made (keys, not addresses).

blur.description: A tiny placeholder image as a base64 data URI.

url.description: Where to show it; null while storage is not connected and no mediaBaseUrl is set.

TaxonomyImageInput.description: The uploaded file: upload it first with POST /v1/catalog/uploads (for category or brand) and the presigned upload.

key.description: The key the upload answered (under ecommerce/categories/<id>/ or ecommerce/brands/<id>/).

sizes.description: Smaller copies you uploaded the same way: thumb, card and detail keys (each checked in the bucket).

blur.description: A tiny placeholder image as a base64 data URI.

TaxonomySeo.description: The SEO fields of a category or brand page (PLAN E16).

title.description: The page's title ('' = made from the name).

description.description: The page's meta description ('' = made from the description).

canonicalUrl.description: '' = the page's own address; else an https address or a path on the website (/…).

ogImage.description: The social image: '' = the record's image; else an https address or a path on the website.

noindex.description: Ask search engines not to index the page.

nofollow.description: Ask search engines not to follow the page's links.

TaxonomySeoInput.description: SEO fields to change; a member left out keeps its value. Texts are trimmed (line breaks become spaces).

title.description: The page's title ('' = made from the name).

description.description: The page's meta description ('' = made from the description).

canonicalUrl.description: '' = the page's own address; else an https address or a path on the website (/…).

ogImage.description: The social image: '' = the record's image; else an https address or a path on the website.

noindex.description: Ask search engines not to index the page.

nofollow.description: Ask search engines not to follow the page's links.

value.description: The text the widgets show.

colors.description: Colour name → #rrggbb (the product's CSS supplies the others).

ValueSource.description: Where a value comes from: saved for this website, the global default, or built in.

items.description: Saved products still active and not hidden, in the order saved.

max.description: Products a wishlist holds at most.
